notes.title: Demo gameplay ends
notes.notes:
Dear Souls,

We have presented the demo version of “Teahouse of Souls”.

Your valuable opinions so far will be much appreciated for the official release version development.

Now, the demo version gameplay will end as of time below.

[b]Nov 22, 2023 19:30(PST)
Nov 23, 2023 03:30(UTC)
Nov 23, 2023 12:30(KST)[/b]

We will keep updating the development progress on our social channels.

Please look forward to the official release of “Teahouse of Souls” in future.

Thank you for your support.

[b]Pixelity Operation Team[/b]

notes.title: "Teahouse of Souls" Upload VR Showcase Summer 2023
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce "Teahouse of Souls" has been showcased at the Upload VR Showcase Summer 2023: a big shoutout to Uploadvr for providing a platform to showcase amazing VR games and connecting gamers!

If you haven't had the chance to watch trailers of "Teahouse of Souls" and "Puttzzle," make sure to watch the UVR summer showcase!

[previewyoutube=d8YuTpN9CQA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


You won't be disappointed!
